programmes.d: The crew struggles to come to terms with an injury to one of their own; a temporary replacement must be dealt with; Boden ponders some interesting news; Kidd has a hard time keeping a secret.

Boden has a lapse in judgment in the aftermath of rescuing a young boy; Kidd struggles to win the approval of Severide's mom after a surprise visit; Otis takes on new responsibilities at the firehouse.

When the FBI takes over the firehouse for an undercover mission, Casey and Severide volunteer to assist with the investigation; Kidd attempts to help Severide come to terms with recent developments he's been managing.
The team responds to a residential fire at a property belonging to a drug cartel; a hefty amount of money is missing from the crime scene; Kidd makes a big decision.

After saving a girl from a car accident, Boden and Severide receive a surprise package; Brett struggles to keep quiet about Cruz reacquainting with his now-married high school sweetheart; a crisis brings Bria back into Dawson's life.

Lt. Severide is shocked when Rene Royce resurfaces; Casey comes up with a plan to help Chief Boden in his latest pursuit; Kidd regrets a decision she made regarding Severide; Herrmann clashes with Lt. Colannino over their son's basketball team.
Boden takes a big step in the pursuit of a major career decision; Kidd becomes increasingly distrustful of Renee's motives with Severide; Herrmann has trouble bouncing back after a tragedy.

Boden's chances for a promotion are met with potential complications; Dawson and Casey don't see eye to eye on an important decision; Kidd finds herself struggling to find time with Severide; Brett and Dawson respond to a tough call.
Torres is dragged into a deadly conspiracy when a routine errand takes a violent turn.
Voight's suspicions ring true when a violent break-in steers the Intelligence Unit back to a chilling figure from a previous case.
Voight and the team work together to uncover the truth of the Bell case before more lives are lost.
Platt finds herself challenged when a simple favor for a former recruit spirals into something far more devastating.

Upton's dogged pursuit of a missing teenage girl leads the team into a dark web of human trafficking; chief O'Neal becomes involved with the unit's investigation when it becomes evident his son, Sean, has a connection to the missing girl.
Atwater's reactions during a tense arrest are called into question; the team must dig in to uncover key evidence that could aid in the ongoing investigation and clear Atwater's name.
When actionable evidence finally surfaces against Sean O'Neal, Upton and the team work relentlessly to build a case in secret; they discover Sean is more elusive and dangerous than anticipated.

To distract Intelligence from the investigation into his son, Chief O'Neal forces the team to handle a "dead fish" case; when that dead fish turns into a complicated heater case, Burgess is thrown back into difficult memories from her past.
Victor Cruz joins the podcast and shares his dream quarterback, gets quizzed on how well he knows himself, ranks touchdown celebrations across the NFL, and builds the ultimate football player.

Hall of Fame NBA Player Tracy McGrady joins the podcast for his first podcast in years! We talk about who the best 1v1 player of all time is, how well does Tracy know himself, how many points we can score in an NBA game, and more!
The invention of breast milk flavored ice cream, announcing our brand-new music channel 'Makeshift Music', will TikTok actually get banned again, what happened to the Hawk Tuah girl, and more!
When Rollins tries to help a friend press rape charges against her lover, she finds herself thrust into the middle of the case.
When Detective Benson faces Lewis in the courtroom, the stress causes setbacks in her recovery; Benson is forced to reveal secrets.
When a suspect is gravely injured and the case becomes a public spectacle, Amaro's badge is on the line; Cragen surprises everyone with an announcement.

When an underage runaway is found beaten and raped, the SVU team works with federal prosecutor Connie Rubirosa (Alana De La Garza); ADA Barba suspects a cover-up when he fails to get the help he needs from Jersey law enforcement.
Amaro suspects the boyfriend of a missing girl is involved with a gang; Sgt. Benson becomes the SVU's new commanding officer.

Reeling from Dawson's continued absence, Casey makes a rash move during a rescue, while Brett struggles with a series of replacement partners; meanwhile, Boden faces scrutiny from Commissioner Grissom, who sends his deputy to monitor Firehouse 51.
